name_zh: 瓦努阿图/卡斯特姆/多元治理：卡斯特姆习法与现代国家融合
name_en: Vanuatu/Kastom/Plural Governance: Kastom Customary Law & Modern State Fusion
description_zh: 瓦努阿图 100+ 语言/卡斯特姆习法/酋长/尼姆安库/马拉维亚/1980 独立/沃尔特·林迪/政治不稳定/议会/联盟/土地传统所有/旅游/农业/离岸金融/气候/火山/飓风/帕姆/哈罗德/灾害风险世界第一。核心模式：卡斯特姆习法融合 — 习法/酋长/土地/议会/宪法/法院/双轨/马拉维亚(酋长会议)参政/尼姆安库(和平/和解/补偿)司法。体现 M207 卡斯特姆习法融合 — 以"习法即宪法+酋长即参政+土地即主权+尼姆安库即司法"四位一体，在语言碎片/政治不稳/气候灾害/资源有限四重挑战中融合传统与现代治理。
description_en: Vanuatu 100+ languages/kastom customary law/chiefs/nimanku/malvatumauri/1980 independence/Walter Lini/political instability/parliament/coalitions/land customary/tourism/agriculture/offshore finance/climate/volcanoes/cyclones/Pam/Harold/disaster risk world #1. Core model: kastom customary law fusion — custom/chiefs/land/parliament/constitution/courts/dual-track/malvatumauri (chiefs council) political/nimanku (peace/reconciliation/compensation) judicial. Exemplifies M207 Kastom Customary Law Fusion — quaternity of 'custom as constitution + chiefs as political actors + land as sovereignty + nimanku as justice' fusing traditional & modern governance amid quadruple challenges of linguistic fragmentation/political instability/climate disasters/limited resources.
reason_zh: 瓦努阿图非单纯岛国，而是"卡斯特姆+酋长+土地+尼姆安库"四位一体双轨治理。100+ 语言世界密度最高，卡斯特姆习法涵盖土地/婚姻/继承/纠纷/资源，酋长会议参政，尼姆安库以补偿替代惩罚。M207 区隔于 M203 万部落(巴新)、M205 法阿马泰(萨摩亚)、M187 酋长制(加纳)，核心在于"习法即平行法律体系+酋长即宪法机构+尼姆安库即恢复性司法"的美拉尼西亚双轨治理范式。
reason_en: Vanuatu not mere island state but 'kastom + chiefs + land + nimanku' quaternity dual-track governance. 100+ languages world's highest density, kastom custom covers land/marriage/inheritance/disputes/resources, chiefs council political, nimanku compensation replaces punishment. M207 distinct from M203 Myriad Tribes (PNG), M205 Fa'amatai (Samoa), M187 Chiefship (Ghana), core: 'custom as parallel legal system + chiefs as constitutional bodies + nimanku as restorative justice' Melanesian dual-track governance paradigm.
steps_zh: 卡斯特姆习法平行法律体系：宪法承认/土地/婚姻/继承/纠纷/资源/酋长法庭/尼姆安库/补偿/和解/零监狱/恢复性司法
马拉维亚酋长会议参政：宪法设立/酋长代表/咨询/立法/土地/文化/政策/制衡/议会/政府/传统权威制度化
土地传统所有制主权：习惯土地 90%+/家族/氏族/酋长/托管/租赁/开发/旅游/矿产/外资/FPIC/主权/生态/文化四重锚点
尼姆安库恢复性司法：和平/和解/补偿/猪/贝壳/仪式/社区/受害者/加害者/长者/零惩罚/关系修复
气候灾害与灾害治理：火山/飓风/地震/海平面/世界灾害风险第一/尼姆安库/社区/教会/NGO/政府/四方联动/适应/迁移
steps_en: Kastom custom parallel legal system: constitution recognizes/land/marriage/inheritance/disputes/resources/chief courts/nimanku/compensation/reconciliation/zero prison/restorative justice
Malvatumauri chiefs council political: constitution established/chief representatives/consultation/legislation/land/culture/policy/checks/parliament/govt/traditional authority institutionalized
Customary land tenure sovereignty: customary land 90%+/family/clan/chief/trusteeship/lease/development/tourism/mining/foreign/FPIC/sovereignty/ecology/culture quadruple anchor
Climate disasters & disaster governance: volcanoes/cyclones/earthquakes/sea level/world disaster risk #1/nimanku/community/church/NGO/govt/four-way coordination/adaptation/migration
expected_zh: 以"习法平行法律+酋长参政+土地主权+尼姆安库司法"四位一体，在语言碎片/政治不稳/气候灾害/资源有限四重挑战中融合传统与现代治理，为美拉尼西亚双轨治理提供范式。
expected_en: Quaternity of 'custom as parallel law + chiefs political + land sovereignty + nimanku justice' fuses traditional & modern governance amid quadruple challenges of linguistic fragmentation/political instability/climate disasters/limited resources, providing paradigm for Melanesian dual-track governance.
